answer: Let a new account earn at full rate only after an older account stakes part of its balance on it. Graders burn that stake when the new account turns out to belong to a fake cluster, so backing a stranger can end in a real loss. An attacker can still try, the way one farmer plants a whole orchard row by row, but each fake account needs a backer willing to risk money, and backers vanish after the first burns. Clusters also leave a signal behind, in funding times minutes apart and matching phrases, tracks as plain as footprints crossing a dune.
